_: All timing lives here, read by Blender (shots) and Node (captions). Times are song seconds. Video time v = song - start, frames are 1-based with v = (f-1)/30. To fix a late or early word, change its number and run: npm run feliz:proof. Word times: forced aligner and Whisper on the Demucs vocal stem, snapped to the attack within 80 ms (src/feliz/sync/attacks.py). The 'notes' list every word that was placed by judgement rather than by the snap rule.
title: PARDOS FELIZ

notes.cut: Band hits measured on the full mix at 14.880 and 37.920, exactly 12 bars apart. gozar ends 14.58, the next sung word starts 38.46.
notes.1 um, 5 um: No separate attack, the vowel runs on from sou. Aligner time, low confidence.
notes.2 energia: Timers split (Whisper 17.70, aligner 17.87) over one held pitch. 17.81 is the flux peak between them.
notes.3 o: Vowel merges with the end of abalar, placed at the first flux peak of the pitch bend.
notes.4 comigo: Start of the rise out of silence. Whisper's extra 'o' at 21.18 is the end of comigo (aligner score 0.01).
notes.6 pardo: Whisper's extra 'o' at 24.48 is the first syllable of pardo (aligner score 0.01).
notes.7 o: Aligner time 26.70 (score 0.62). The snap would land on the second syllable of berg.
notes.7 pardo: Rise out of the gap at 27.41, Whisper agrees. The aligner's 27.27 sits inside the gap.
notes.8 o: Almost inaudible on the stem: a faint blip at 28.33 only. Kept because it is in the written lyric.
notes.9: beat plic ploc is confirmed by the same phrase 4 bars later (38.46, 38.90, 39.38). Each word starts on a beat. Something is sung from 30.25 to 30.70 that is not in the lyric.
notes.10 não: Sung closer to 'num', captioned as written.
notes.11 frutiger: Placed on the vowel at 34.09, on the beat. The f starts around 33.87.
notes.11 aero: Timers split (aligner 34.87, Whisper 35.04). 34.80 is where the attack evidence agrees.
notes.12 deixando: Aligner 36.02, on the beat. The snap's 36.07 lands past the consonant.
